verified: HKUST researchers published the work in Nature Photonics as the November 2026 cover article (Volume 20, Issue 11), and both the paper's abstract and the HKUST announcement confirm a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.67%, with the team's best cell reaching 27.04%; the paper also reports that 92% of tested devices held T80 lifetimes of at least 1,400 hours under maximum-power-point tracking and one-sun illumination.
unconfirmed: The certification body is not named in either the paper abstract or the pv magazine report, the 27.04% figure is the team's own best-cell measurement rather than the certified value, and nothing in the available reporting shows independent replication, module-scale or commercial manufacturing data, or a cost and production timeline — the paper's claim that TIE extends to other multilayer optoelectronic devices also remains untested outside this study.

verified: 香港科技大学团队在《Nature Photonics》发表论文（2026年11月第20卷第11期封面文章），其转界面工程（TIE）制备的钙钛矿电池获得26.67%的认证效率，最佳器件效率为27.04%；在最大功率点跟踪与一个太阳光照条件下，92%的受测器件T80寿命不低于1,400小时（T80指效率降至初始值80%所需时间）。以上数据来自论文本身及HKUST的新闻稿。
unconfirmed: 认证效率由哪家机构出具，报道未披露；27.04%为实验室最佳器件数据，并非独立认证值；T80结果全部来自实验室加速测试，尚无户外实证或组件级放大数据；论文所称“可扩展至其他多层光电器件”目前仅为作者判断。

titles.en: HKUST perovskite solar cell reaches 27.04% via trans-interface engineering
